name: ApexClaw GPU Optimizer
description: Multi-tier model routing optimized for low-end GPUs (8GB VRAM). Routes tasks across local models (Ollama/vLLM), free APIs (NVIDIA NIM, Grok), and paid APIs (Claude, Grok Pro) based on task complexity and cost.

gpuVramMb.description: Available GPU VRAM in MB. Default: 8192 (8GB for GTX 1070 Ti).

localOllamaUrl.description: Ollama base URL for local GPU inference. Default: http://127.0.0.1:11434

localVllmUrl.description: vLLM base URL for custom Qwen3 MoE. Default: http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1

tier.description: Force a specific tier: local, free-api, paid-api, or auto (default).

maxLocalConcurrency.description: Max concurrent local model inferences. Default: 1 for 8GB VRAM.

tradingMode.description: Enable trading-specific agent templates and RBI pipeline routing.

fleetNodes.description: Fleet of GPU nodes for distributed inference.
